whyMatters.en: NYC band with Warhol association; The Velvet Underground & Nico (1967) delayed-influence blueprint for punk, noise, and indie’s drone/dissonance.
whyMatters.zh: 与 Warhol 关联的纽约乐队；The Velvet Underground & Nico（1967）是朋克、噪声与 indie 持续音/不协和的延迟影响蓝图。

shortBio.en: Reed / Cale avant-rock; Heroin is the early drone-narrative piece.
shortBio.zh: Reed / Cale 的前卫摇滚；Heroin 是早期持续音叙事曲。

body.en:
Formed 1964. Debut with Nico, White Light/White Heat, and later Reed-led albums used viola drone, feedback, deadpan lyric, and minimal chord vamps outside AM-psych fashion.

Heroin (1967) is the listed track. Commercial failure at release; citation density in punk/post-punk/indie histories is the measure of impact.
body.zh:
1964 年组建。与 Nico 的首专、White Light/White Heat 及后期 Reed 主导专辑：中提琴持续音、反馈、冷脸歌词、极少和弦反复，落在 AM 迷幻时尚之外。

Heroin（1967）是列出曲目。发行时商业失败；朋克/后朋克/indie 史中的引用密度才是影响尺度。
